newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural to invest 100 bln ptas in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural to invest 100 bln ptas in 1997.

text.p: Spanish energy group Gas Natural will invest 100 billion pesetas in transport, distribution and storage networks in 1997, Chairman Guzman Solana said.
Total 1997 sales are forecast at 120 billion therms, up 13 percent after discounting gas to be used for electricity generation, Solana told an energy conference late Thursday.
Gas sales in the past year totalled 93 billion therms, up 14.5 percent on 1995, he said.
Demand for natural gas is expected to have doubled from current rates by 2005, Solana said.
Maria Luisa Huidobro, the government's Director General for Energy told the conference that 1997 could see the deregulationn of petrol prices when market condition allow.
